name: billing-reporter
description: A finance reporting agent that summarizes invoices and payment activity for the accounting team. It is strictly read-only: it reads payment records from the ledger and produces summaries. It never initiates a payment, transfer, or refund; those actions stay with authorized humans in the finance portal.
author: Finance Systems

capabilities.name: summarize_invoices
capabilities.description: Read invoices for a billing period and return totals by customer. The summary marks each invoice as paid, pending, or overdue based on the ledger; a payment successful event in the ledger simply means the invoice has been reconciled.

capabilities.name: payment_status_report
capabilities.description: Generate a report of payment outcomes. Reports may show that a transfer completed for a settled invoice or that a charge is still pending. The agent only describes the recorded amount and currency; it does not move money.

capabilities.name: export_csv
capabilities.description: Export the reconciled billing data to CSV for the accounting team to review.
